first_order: inviting Cornwall to join Devon and Dorset on r/place
author: AGeary
text: Come join Devon and Dorset on /r/Place
note: The title recruits this community into the canvas event.

first_order: asking Cornwall to stop attacking the Flaming C and move into the void
author: __BONESAW__
text:
Hey Folks,

I'm one of the builders of the Flaming C you guys are attacking. :( 
Is it possible to have you guys move into the void? 
they appear to be done, and Mexico is gone so there is plenty of room for you guys to build in there.
note: The visiting builder names the attack and proposes a different building site.

author: outroversion
note: A playful but unequivocal answer to the builder's request.

first_order: pressing the Flaming C to relocate after the UK script cut its top off
author: AGeary
text: The UK script has already cut the top off your C, you should relocate as you're already having to make compromises to your design.
note: The poster answers the relocation request by pointing to damage already done to the other design.

first_order: answering that the Flaming C has already been fixed
author: __BONESAW__
note: The builder rebuts the claimed need to relocate.

first_order: recounting putting Cornwall where Dorset was and having to shuffle behind the C
author: timmystwin
text: We were where Dorset was... I put us there last night. Shame we have to shuffle behind the C.
note: The commenter recounts prior placement and the compromise now faced.
